final_candidates.decision_summary: K321 is in the 320s loop, a key component of the m102.4 epitope on the periphery of the receptor-binding site. Alanine substitution removes the charged side chain likely making critical electrostatic contacts with m102.4 CDR loops while being unlikely to disrupt ephrin-B2 binding in the central cleft.

R326 is also in the 320s loop with a large positively charged guanidinium group likely making key contacts with m102.4. Alanine substitution removes this side chain, disrupting antibody binding, while this peripheral loop position is unlikely to be critical for ephrin-B2 receptor engagement.

Y239 is in the 236-240 region near the receptor-binding site and likely contacted by m102.4. The conservative Y-to-F substitution removes the hydroxyl group (disrupting a potential hydrogen bond with m102.4) while preserving the aromatic ring for structural integrity and possible ephrin-B2 contacts.

stop_reason.detail: Positions have been verified against the sequence, candidates are grounded in structural knowledge of the m102.4 epitope and ephrin-B2 binding site, and no external tools are available to further refine predictions.
